title: Claude 3.5 Sonnet
before: Capability tracked size, so the flagship was always the largest model.
problem: The largest model is also the slowest and most expensive to serve.
breakthrough: A mid-tier model outperforming the previous flagship at a fraction of the cost and latency.
why: It broke the assumption that frontier capability requires frontier size, and made strong models cheap enough for agents to call repeatedly.
next: The 3.5 line gained computer use in October, then 3.7 added extended thinking.
inherits: Cheap frontier-class models as the substrate for agent loops.
